validity.recommendation: Human de-dup/segmentation decision: P6687, P0474 and P3934 are three GEM ProjectIDs for ONE physical trunk (the Western Desert Gas Project North Line, Obaiyed field -> Ameriya). gem.wiki itself lists all three as sub-sections of a single 'Obaiyed-Amreya Northern Gas Pipeline'. Decide whether to keep one network row or genuine physical segments; do NOT leave three parallel 'operating' rows each carrying a full capacity (480 + 600 + 950 MMcf/d) that triple-counts the same trunk.
validity.researcher_notes: The gem.wiki article 'Obaiyed-Amreya Northern Gas Pipeline' describes ONE network ('The Northern Gas Pipeline, or Obaiyed-Amreya gas pipeline ... running from Obaiyed gas field to Amreya oil & gas plant') and then splits it into three named sub-sections under 'Pipeline Details', each of which is a separate GEM row: (a) 'Obaiyed-Tarek Gas Pipeline' = 600 MMcf/d, 49.5 km, 32 in = P0474; (b) 'Tarek-Ameryia Gas Pipeline' = 950 MMcf/d, 231 km, 34 in = P3934; (c) 'Obaiyed Spurline' = 480 MMcf/d, 41.5 km, 26 in = THIS row P6687. All three carry the identical parent name 'Obaiyed-Amreya Northern Gas Pipeline' in the roster (P0474 Obaiyed gas field->Alexandria 49.5/32/600; P3934 ?->Alexandria 231/34/950; P6687 Obaiyed->Alexandria 41.5/26/480). Independent GulfPub PE World Map records exactly ONE line for this corridor: 'Western Desert Gas Project - North Line | Obaiyed field -> Ameriya Refinery | op=BAPETCO dia=34.0 len_km=196.0 start_year=1999'. OGJ ('Egypt western desert activity hits high gear') independently describes ONE ~315 km line from Shell's Obaiyed concession to Egypt's gas grid and the 640 MW Ameriya power plant, service 1999, carrying Shell ~300 MMcfd + Repsol/Apache Khalda ~165 MMcfd (~465 MMcfd total). So the real object is a single Obaiyed->Ameriya trunk; GEM's three-row split is a segmentation/double-count artifact and the three capacities cannot all be independent throughputs of one pipe.

validity.recommendation: Verify the 'Obaiyed Spurline' exists as a distinct 41.5 km / 26 in / 480 MMcf/d line before keeping it. Its sole cited source does not name it or contain any of its numbers, and its stated endpoints (Obaiyed -> Amreya, ~275-315 km apart) are impossible for a 41.5 km line. Likely a short tie-in spur near the Obaiyed field mislabeled with the parent network's endpoints, or a phantom sub-row.
validity.researcher_notes: Every value cell on P6687 (Status/Fuel/Type/Capacity 480/Length 41.5/Diameter 26/Owner) cites ONE source: egyptoil-gas.com/reports/the-western-desert-egypts-giant-petroleum-reservoir/. url_verifier returns 200 but the page (a 2020 Egypt Oil & Gas PDF report) contains NONE of 'Obaiyed', 'Ameriya', 'Amreya', 'operating', or '41.5' -- confirmed independently by fetching the PDF: it does not name this pipeline or list any of these specs. The prior ref-sweep already flagged the same (Status and Length not found on the page). The gem.wiki page's other two refs are [1] 'World Energy Atlas, Petroleum Economist, 2001' -- i.e. the Petroleum Economist / PE World Map, the SAME origin as the Tier-2 GulfPub dataset, so not independent of GulfPub -- and [2] an Apache 2004 EIA (miga.org) which supports only general network existence + Apache/Shell ownership 'as of 2004', not the spurline's specs. INTERNAL INCONSISTENCY: the row is labeled a 41.5 km 'Obaiyed Spurline' but its endpoints are Obaiyed field (Matruh gov) -> Amreya (Alexandria gov), which are ~275-315 km apart per OGJ -- a 41.5 km segment cannot span that. Net: the Obaiyed->Ameriya trunk clearly exists (OGJ, GulfPub), but the distinct 'Obaiyed Spurline' as specced (41.5/26/480, Obaiyed->Amreya) has zero independent corroboration and an impossible geometry.

validity.recommendation: Revisit owner/operator: sheet has Owner1 = 'General Petroleum Co' 100%. Independent sources point to the JV/operators Shell + Apache/Repsol (Khalda) and BAPETCO (a Shell-EGPC JV) as operator; GPC is at best a nominal EGPC-side owner. Confirm operator=BAPETCO/Khalda and split ownership rather than a single 100% GPC owner.
validity.researcher_notes: gem.wiki lists the Obaiyed-Tarek segment operator as 'Apache Corporation and Shell' and owner 'General Petroleum Company (GPC)'; the sheet's operators/owners tab (oo_sheet_row 5343) has Owner1='General Petroleum Co' 100%, cited only to the egyptoil-gas page (which does not support it). Independent evidence: OGJ says the Obaiyed->Ameriya project was built/run by Shell + Repsol/Apache (Khalda gas); GulfPub gives operator = Badr El Din Petroleum Company (BAPETCO), the Shell-EGPC Western Desert JV. So a single 100% 'General Petroleum Co' owner is at least incomplete and probably wrong for the operator; treat as an attribution caveat pending confirmation.

routes.start_name: Obaiyed gas field, Matruh governorate, Western Desert, Egypt
routes.end_name: Amreya (El Amreya) oil & gas plant, SW of Alexandria, Egypt (parent-network terminus; NOT reachable by a 41.5 km segment)
routes.corridor_desc: The PARENT network (Western Desert Gas Project North Line) runs ENE ~275-315 km from the Obaiyed gas field (~50 km south of the Mediterranean coast, Matruh governorate, Khalda concession area) across the northern Western Desert coastal strip to the Amreya oil & gas / refinery complex SW of Alexandria (Ameriya, Alexandria governorate). This row P6687 is only a ~41.5 km 'Obaiyed Spurline', so it CANNOT span the full Obaiyed->Amreya corridor; its true endpoints are undetermined and are most plausibly a short tie-in spur in the Obaiyed field / Khalda concession area feeding the trunk. Only the corridor of the whole network is defensible; the specific 41.5 km spur cannot be located from sources. Bound is loose.
routes.researcher_notes: Obaiyed field coordinates 31.249N, 26.568E from a published geophysical reservoir-evaluation study of the field (approximate; field is ~50 km south of the Mediterranean coast, Matruh gov). Ameriya (El Amreya) plant coordinates ~31.01N, 29.80E defensible from the well-known Al Amiriyah/Amreya industrial area SW of Alexandria; not source-pinned to the meter, hence approximate. Corridor length/route corroborated by OGJ (~315 km Obaiyed->Ameriya) and GulfPub (North Line 34 in, 196 km). No coordinates fabricated; the 41.5 km spur's endpoints are left as the network termini with an explicit caveat that the segment cannot reach Amreya.

summary: P6687 'Obaiyed Spurline' is one of three GEM rows (with P0474, P3934) for ONE physical Obaiyed->Ameriya WDGP North Line trunk (concerns: duplicate/segmentation, unsupported+geometrically-impossible spurline specs, and GPC-only attribution); real trunk exists (OGJ/GulfPub) but this sub-row does not stand alone.
